attributes.name: Knormal
attributes.description: Volumetric stiffness in the contact normal direction (units: stress/length)

attributes.name: Kshear
attributes.description: Volumetric stiffness in the contact shear direction (units: stress/length)

attributes.name: kn_i
attributes.description: Currently, we assume kn_i and Knormal are adopting the same value in Ip2 initialisation

attributes.name: ks_i
attributes.description: Currently, we assume ks_i and Kshear are adopting the same value in Ip2 initialisation

attributes.name: useFaceProperties
attributes.description: Whether to get face properties from the intersecting particles

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.
